messages.author: a7b4b8806b78ccd8
messages.subject: problem with installing natverse
parts:
Dear Greg I hope you are well.

I am trying to install natverse using the following in R studio:

install.packages("natmanager") natmanager::install('natverse') 

I get the following error:

Error: `github_token()` was deprecated in usethis 2.0.0 and is now defunct.
Call `gh::gh_token()` to retrieve a GitHub personal access token
Call `gh_token_help()` if you need help getting or configuring your token 

I already have the token in the Renviron. 

I would really appreciate it if you could help me.

Best Regards
Ibrahim

messages.author: 7f0257cd1389289f
messages.subject: Re: problem with installing natverse
parts:
Hi Ibrahim, this is due to an incompatible change in one of the dependencies, the usethis package. We have an issue already 

https://github.com/natverse/natmanager/issues/15

and Sri is working on a fix which I expect will be ready tomorrow. If you need to to get round this in the meantime, you can roll usethis back to version 2.0 using remotes::install_github. 

All the best,

Greg. 

Sent from my iPhone

On Tue, Dec 15, 2020 at 1:03 AM S.R. Jagannathan <sr...@cam.ac.uk> wrote:
Hi Ibrahim,
I have already made a fix for this, which you can avail by using:

devtools::install_github('natverse/natmanager')


Currently, the release in the cran would be delayed a bit due to queuing
issues with the CI travis side.

Kind regards,
Sridhar Jagannathan
